summary.text: Nicole Grohoski is a Democratic state senator from Maine Senate District 7 who assumed office on July 6, 2022, and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A cartographer by profession, she served in the Maine House of Representatives from 2018 to 2022.

paragraphs.text: Nicole Grohoski earned a bachelor's degree in environmental studies and chemistry from Middlebury College in 2005.
Her career experience includes working as a cartographer and GIS specialist.

She has served as board secretary for the Northern Forest Canoe Trail, as a WMA Wilderness first responder, and as a volunteer firefighter with the Winooski Fire Department, and she has been affiliated with the Ellsworth Green Plan and the Maine Master Naturalist Program.
Grohoski represented House District 132 from 2018 to 2022, succeeding Louis Luchini, who was also her predecessor in the Senate seat for District 7.
